arguments:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'SilentlyContinue'
'ACTIVE_USER:'
Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_ComputerSystem | Select-Object UserName | Format-List
'EXPLORER_PROCESSES:'
Get-Process -Name explorer | Select-Object Id,SessionId,StartTime,Path | Format-List
'EXPLORER_BINARY:'
Get-Item -LiteralPath 'C:\Windows\explorer.exe' | Select-Object FullName,Length,VersionInfo | Format-List
exit 0
